evUnit: bb, relative to the start of the hand; sampled (see evStdError); depends on the EQR model

model.extrapolations: 4-bet+ pots use the 3-bet factors; multiway flops use single-raised factors with 'in position' = last to act
model.name: eqr-v2
model.source: measured from OpenRange postflop solves (solver-cli calibrate-eqr)

provenance.notes: 6-max cash preflop, rake-free, blinds 0.5/1. Postflop play is not solved: when a hand reaches the flop each player's pot share is all-in equity × an equity-realization factor (see `model`: eqr-v1 authored, or eqr-v2 measured from postflop solves). Multiway pots also approximate equity from heads-up matchups. Tree simplifications are listed in `tree`. CFR with six players has no equilibrium guarantee; bestResponseGainBb estimates the gain from changing single decisions.

simplifications: at most one cold call of an open (blinds may always call)
facing a 3-bet, players who have not put money in may only fold
facing a 4-bet or 5-bet only the previous raiser continues
